description: Bayesian hierarchical spatio-temporal model for climate-sensitive disease, built on R-INLA. Wraps BSC's GHRmodel package (dhis2-workflow branch), running a single user-specified model configuration with configurable spatial, seasonal and interannual random effects and lagged/rolling climate covariates.

model_metadata.author: Global Health Resilience group, BSC (wrapped for CHAP by HISP Centre)
model_metadata.citation_info: Lowe R, Lee SA, O'Reilly KM et al. (2021) Combined effects of hydrometeorological hazards and urbanisation on dengue risk in Brazil: a spatiotemporal modelling study. The Lancet Planetary Health. https://doi.org/10.1016/S2542-5196(20)30292-8
